uutiset.t: Jakirovic full of praise for Tzolakis performance
uutiset.s: Hull head coach Sergej Jakirovic is pleased with his side's "precise" counter-attacking to earn a victory over Brighton, and describes goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis' performance as "unbelievable."

uutiset.t: 'Rolls-Royce' Iqbal's 'dream' journey from Old Trafford to Tannadice
uutiset.s: Zidane Iqbal is starting to live up to his famous name and wowing Scottish Premiership fans after his move to Dundee United.

uutiset.t: Spurs 'a match for anyone' as European hopes boosted
uutiset.s: With the Women's Super League big four firmly established, and London City Lionesses spending their way into European contention, Champions League dreams could have seemed more fanciful than ever for Tottenham Hotspur. But they are firmly in the mix.

uutiset.t: PSG's Doue to have surgery on ruptured ACL
uutiset.s: Paris St-Germain forward Desire Doue will have surgery later this month after rupturing the anterior cruciate ligament in his right knee.

uutiset.t: Liu Wenwei suspended amid match-fixing investigation
uutiset.s: Chinese snooker player Liu Wenwei is suspended from "attending or competing on the World Snooker Tour with immediate effect" amid an investigation into match-fixing.

uutiset.t: Did beaten Wales still show they have come a long way?
uutiset.s: Wales believe they are on the up despite failing to back up their win against New Zealand when beaten by Australia in the Nations Championship.

uutiset.t: Marquez wins record-equalling eighth MotoGP title
uutiset.s: Marc Marquez secures a record-equalling eighth MotoGP championship and moves level with Giacomo Agostini.

uutiset.t: Northern Ireland complete series win over Gibraltar
uutiset.s: Northern Ireland Warriors beat Gibraltar Campions 71-30 to complete a Test double in Antrim.

uutiset.t: Frick delivers on 'heavy metal football' promise
uutiset.s: Mario Frick aimed for "heavy metal football" after taking over from Aberdeen and travelling fans were served up quite the concert at Rugby Park.

uutiset.t: England will not get carried away by beating All Blacks
uutiset.s: In his latest BBC Sport column, England World Cup winner Matt Dawson reflects on Steve Borthwick's side's record win over New Zealand and previews the final round of Nations Championship fixtures.

uutiset.t: Watford seek sixth manager in 18 months after sacking Dionisi
uutiset.s: Watford sack head coach Alessio Dionisi after 18 games in charge.

uutiset.t: Did Springboks win change the narrative for Ireland?
uutiset.s: After a 20-17 win on Saturday, did Ireland's victory over South Africa change the narrative for Andy Farrell's side?

uutiset.t: Verstappen a constant amid chaos as he says Russell is 'so far below my level'
uutiset.s: Max Verstappen was the star figure in a Las Vegas Grand Prix that was unlike any F1 race anyone younger than about 70 had ever seen.

uutiset.t: Scotland must let promising McConnell loose against Pumas
uutiset.s: Scotland head into their Nations Championship finale against Argentina on a high and should unleash Liam McConnell on the Pumas after his hat-trick against Japan, writes Tom English.

uutiset.t: NFL player Harrell in hospital after alleged driver assault
uutiset.s: Tennessee Titans linebacker Jaylen Harrell is in hospital after a car crash in Florida, with police investigating whether he assaulted a taxi driver.
